value.rationale: The generalized coefficient Lebesgue factor is a motivated sharp stability/relaxed-representer invariant for sparse nonconvex kernel interpolation. The closed phase diagram reveals a nontrivial symmetry-breaking of the worst input center, explicit sharp threshold and exponent, a quantitative large-separation defect, and elementary complete half-power regime. These details are not routine numerical samples or a mere rephrasing of the general representer theorem.
